summary: Several studies have directly applied gradient boosted trees to traffic forecasting. Gupta et al. (2023) [V0231] used AgriSat-4 and achieved an accuracy of 0.85. Fischer et al. (2022) [V0230] applied the method to Atlas-ICU, obtaining an F1 score of 0.78. Haddad et al. (2024) [V0232] compared baselines with boosted decision-tree ensembles on LedgerGuard, reporting an MAE of 0.92. El-Sayed et al. (2021) [V0229] studied the method on MetroFlow and reported an AUROC of 0.71. Duarte et al. (2020) [V0225] used a decentralised training approach without pooled records on MetroFlow, achieving an MAE of 0.6.
